name: Alborache (Spain)
description: Yellow field with blue stripes along the upper and lower edges, charged at the centre with the crowned arms of Alborache (a tower on blue and bezants on red).
history: The flag proposal of 2007 is a rectangular cloth of proportion 2:3, yellow, with two blue stripes along the upper and lower edges of a tenth of the width, with the municipal arms in their colours superimposed at the centre; the proposal was approved by the full council on 27 March 2007. The official arms were approved by the Generalitat Valenciana on 28 April 2022.

features.role: Alborache arms — tower on blue and bezants on red
